intro.title: Original Sphatik Malas, Crystal Quartz Necklaces
intro.descriptionHtml: Collection of Crystal Mala with various bead shapes. Crystal Quartz (Sphatik) Malas have been worn and used as Japamala since time immemorial, as it holds the vibration of the Mantra and amplifies it. Crystal Quartz is excellent in healing and balancing the Sahasrara/Crown Chakra, which expands consciousness and awareness, augments spiritual growth, brings clarity of thoughts, enhances focus, memory, helps to connection with Divine realm. Crystal stone calms down the mind, clears the aura, aids in meditation and has several healing properties. These are essential Malas for everyone.
